note: What a server sends to stop an animation a unit is playing. The header names the unit.

bits.name: fade
bits.note: Set where the animation fades out.

bits.name: ignoreLock
bits.note: Set where a lock on the animation is ignored.

bits.name: stopAll
bits.note: Set where every animation stops when the name below is empty.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: animation
fields.note: The animation's name, ended by a zero byte, or empty.
